RECONSTRUCTION_FIDELITY.pass: At least 0.80 of independently preregistered source-anchor slots are recovered and there are no critical unsupported additions.
RECONSTRUCTION_FIDELITY.partial: At least 0.50 but less than 0.80 of anchor slots are recovered, with no critical unsupported addition.
RECONSTRUCTION_FIDELITY.fail: Below 0.50 anchor recovery or any critical unsupported addition that changes source scope or direction.

CONTINUATION_CORRECTNESS.pass: All preregistered must-preserve constraints, prerequisites, and stop conditions are satisfied; no prohibited action is executed.
CONTINUATION_CORRECTNESS.fail: Any must-preserve constraint is violated or a prohibited action is executed.

NON_EQUIVALENCE_CONTROL.pass: 8/8 controls retain their stated distinctions and conditional claim ceilings.
NON_EQUIVALENCE_CONTROL.fail: Any control is accepted without its required distinction or ceiling.

NOVEL_OBJECT_STRUCTURALIZATION.pass: Objects, relations, source locators, uncertainty, boundaries, unknowns, obligations, and a bounded proposal are all present; every material statement is source-grounded or explicitly marked inferred/unknown.
NOVEL_OBJECT_STRUCTURALIZATION.fail: A required structural field is absent, material statements lack locators, or unknowns/boundaries are silently filled.

overall_reporting: Report every dimension and case separately. Do not collapse outcomes into a cognitive-inheritance, capability, model-improvement, external-truth, or R1 verdict.
change_control: Thresholds are frozen before the successor outputs. Any later change invalidates confirmatory use and must be reported as exploratory only.
